In Geography add a list of ‘Départements’ where the front is a number and the back is the department name. Then do another list ‘Prefectures’ where the front is the département name and the back is the préfecture city. In both cases do not forget the 97x outre-mer ones.

We need lists for conjuations in Spanish. Front is the verb name in spanish. and back is the list of 6 forms (on 6 lines) at a given tense. We need 1/3 of regular verbs and 2/3 of irregular ones. Around 60 verbs is quite fine. We need 'Présent' 'Subjonctif présent', 'Subjonctif Imparfait forme 1' et 'Subjonctif Imparfait forme 2'.
